limits: Service Map units are registry entries, including outdoor features; they are not a census of unique buildings or service capacity.
Population is measured at 31 December 2025; current service and district snapshots have a different observation date.
Counts and units per 10000 residents are descriptive indicators, not accessibility, adequacy or service quality.
Null geometry, unmatched and boundary-ambiguous locations are reported separately; no silent reassignment.
The 100 m district-ID raster is a cartographic test derivative, not a population grid.
No permanent availability or global city ranking is claimed. Pinned public snapshots support offline reproduction.
quality.population_reconciliation: 13682 is the arithmetic difference between the municipal total and the 34 selected statistical district rows in this snapshot.
